# Observability Checklist: G56R-001 Candidate Route Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for source-audit evidence, telemetry field coverage, traceability, and reviewable handoff signals.

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirements quality, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are official source records required to expose source family, retrieval method, requested URL, canonical URL, retrieval timestamp, durable retrieval evidence, page or section locator, short excerpt anchor, bounded source-fact extracts, extract hashes, and invalidation triggers? [Completeness, Spec FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Are candidate routes required to bind visible official source IDs, role contract IDs, and effort-surface records? [Completeness, Spec FR-011]
- [x] CHK003 Are telemetry requirements complete for assigned route, effective route, model, effort, tools, skills, MCP, sandbox, approvals, token usage, duration, retries, terminal state, and missing-field classification? [Completeness, Spec FR-016]
- [x] CHK004 Are active route-policy project-input surfaces inventoried without making them platform authority? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are go/no-go decisions required to name incomplete or not-recorded evidence instead of silently proceeding? [Completeness, Spec FR-018]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Are prompt-emulation fixture records clearly labeled as non-release evidence? [Clarity, Spec FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Is the report's strict no-runtime boundary observable from changed-file scope evidence? [Clarity, Plan Verification Strategy]

## Requirement Consistency
